name: security-committee
description: Advanced Track: a security committee for every GitHub pull request on Cloudflare (Agents SDK, Workflows, Workers AI + Clef). The Starter Track lives in ./starter.

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Any long random string. Type the same value into your GitHub webhook's Secret field.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub token for the repos to review: Pull requests (read and write), Issues (read and write), Commit statuses (read and write), Contents (read), Metadata (read).

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Optional. A long random string that unlocks the policy and audit API. Leave empty to keep that API off.
